load_single_dataset: load a single HuggingFace dataset by name and config into a DatasetDict
create_dataset_mixture: create a mixture of multiple datasets with column selection and weighting
subsample_dataset_by_weight: subsample a dataset to a fraction of its size using a weight parameter
split_dataset_train_test: split a combined dataset into train and test sets with a given test size
review_get_dataset: review the get_dataset function to understand how it loads single or mixed datasets
